  "overall_assessment": "anomalies",
  "findings": [
    {
      "benefit": "Death",
      "years": [2021, 2022],
      "pattern": "shock",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+0.35 step (A/E rises from ~0.95 to ~1.29)",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_death_by_year.csv: A/E jumps abruptly to 1.296 in 2021 and holds flat at 1.282 in 2022 with no gradual ramp; reverts to 0.860 in 2023.",
        "Evidence pack identifies a shaped-pulse excursion (score 25.7) consistent with a one-off level change."
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Investigate 2021-2022 death claims for data recording errors, catastrophic single-event payouts, or sales mix shifts. If confirmed, exclude the shock window from trend analysis and update pricing/valuation assumptions accordingly."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "CI",
      "years": [2021, 2022],
      "pattern": "shock",
      "direction": "decrease",
      "magnitude": "~−0.45 step (A/E drops from ~1.11 to ~0.66)",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ci_by_year.csv: A/E falls sharply to 0.670 in 2021 and stays at 0.654 in 2022; rebounds to 1.147 in 2023.",
        "Evidence pack identifies a shaped-pulse excursion (score 36.9) consistent with a one-off level change; elevated scatter is driven by this step, not independent volatility."
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Review 2021-2022 CI claims for systematic under-reporting, coding/classification changes, or external reporting delays. If genuine, adjust assumptions; if data error, correct and re-run experience analysis."
    }
  ]
}

  1.0, with sampling noise of order 1/sqrt(expected claim count) per year.
- Anomalies, when present, are one of:

    set years to the FULL window of the trend INCLUDING the gentle early ramp

    flat-topped or single-year excursions. If the excursion rises year over year
    before it peaks or reverts, prefer drift.
